fit.why: Multiple reviews (4★ and 3★) state the dress fits true to size and waist defined nicely; no evidence of needing a different size for a shopper who usually wears M and had a perfect previous fit.

quality.why: Reviews focus on fit and length; none comment on fabric, stitching, or durability, so quality cannot be assessed reliably.

look.styling_tip: Pair with sandals or wedges and a thin belt to accentuate the waist for brunch or garden parties.

what_would_settle_it: Exact bust and waist measurements of a shopper who bought size M and their fit feedback
Additional reviews mentioning fabric feel, stitching quality, or durability

overall.one_line: Fit appears true to size for M, but quality details are missing; the dress is suitable for casual daytime occasions.
